description: Redwood RunMyJobs (RMJ / SAP Redwood Scheduler) REST API integration. Each declared JobDefinition becomes a daily-partitioned Dagster asset with a retry policy. Ships with 5 ops + jobs (restart, hold, release, kill, reconcile), an external-execution monitor sensor, an inbound-trigger sensor, and an hourly reconciliation schedule. demo_mode=true simulates the full REST API lifecycle on stdout so the whole component runs end-to-end with zero external dependencies.

outputs.description: One daily-partitioned Dagster asset per RunMyJobs JobDefinition + optional external source-table assets + 5 ops/jobs + 2 sensors + 1 schedule.

demo_mode.label: Demo Mode
demo_mode.description: Simulate the REST API on stdout (no external calls).

endpoint.label: Endpoint
endpoint.description: RunMyJobs REST API base URL (used when demo_mode=false).

jobs.label: Jobs
jobs.description: RunMyJobs JobDefinitions to wrap as daily-partitioned Dagster assets. Each item: {job_definition, asset_name, description?, application?, partition_type?, sub_partition_type?, queue?, run_as?}.

source_tables.label: Source Tables
source_tables.description: Tables loaded by RunMyJobs that Dagster observes (adds to lineage). Each item: {table_name, asset_name, description?, group_name?, produced_by?}.

upstream_deps.label: Upstream Deps
upstream_deps.description: Upstream asset keys (slash-separated for nested keys) that must complete before jobs run.

group_name.label: Group Name
group_name.description: Dagster asset group for the job assets.

runmyjobs_user_env.label: RunMyJobs User Env Var
runmyjobs_user_env.description: Env var holding the RunMyJobs REST username.

runmyjobs_password_env.label: RunMyJobs Password Env Var
runmyjobs_password_env.description: Env var holding the RunMyJobs REST password.

poll_interval_seconds.label: Poll Interval Seconds
poll_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between RunMyJobs process status polls.

poll_timeout_seconds.label: Poll Timeout Seconds
poll_timeout_seconds.description: Total seconds to wait for terminal status before failing.

partition_start_date.label: Partition Start Date
partition_start_date.description: Start date for the daily partitioned assets.

reconciliation_cron.label: Reconciliation Cron
reconciliation_cron.description: Cron for the RunMyJobs vs Dagster state reconciliation job.

name: RunMyJobsIntegration
